observations: Photo 0 shows a Nikon camera body mounted on a rig/handle with a lens attached; multiple cardboard boxes around it.
Photo 0 includes a box with large text that appears to read “D750”.
Photo 1 shows Nikon packaging/manual inserts inside an open box; no clear serial number or body label visible.
Photo 2 shows items packed in bubble wrap inside the box; contents not clearly identifiable.

claims.evidence: No photo shows the camera’s origin/region or any documentation proving it’s “American used”; only Nikon/D750 text on packaging is visible (photo 0).
Photos do not show close-ups of the sensor, shutter count area, buttons/ports, or any wear; only boxed/rigged views (photos 0-2).
No photo/video of the camera powering on, showing menus, autofocus, shutter actuation, or saving a test shot (photos 0-2).

risks.risk: Body may not be Nikon D750 (model mismatch) or the box text may not match the actual camera.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the camera’s model marking/label on the body (and/or the EXIF “Model” shown after powering on).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used Nikon DSLR body with unknown condition (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Not actually “body only” (may be bundled with lens/rig or missing expected accessories).
risks.proof: Ask for a full contents photo laid out: body, lens (if any), battery, charger, cables, manuals, and any caps.
risks.if_unproven: Price as body-only with missing/unknown accessories (worst case).

risks.risk: Condition/defects: shutter wear, stuck buttons, faulty ports, or sensor issues not visible in boxed photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video: power on → menu screen → take a test photo → playback image; plus a close-up of the sensor at high magnification (or a sample image of a blank wall at f/8).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed (worst case: may need service).

risks.risk: Possible non-functionality or battery/charger issues (camera may not power properly).
risks.proof: Ask for a photo/video showing the camera powered on with battery installed and charging/indicator working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working until proven.

risks.risk: Packaging could be misleading; items in bubble wrap (photo 2) may not be the camera or may be incomplete.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of everything removed from the box and identified one-by-one.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the camera body label/model marking (not just box text).
Video or photos showing the camera powered on: menu screen + taking and reviewing a test shot.
Photo of sensor condition (or a test image of a uniform surface at a small aperture).
Full list of included items laid out (battery, charger, cables, caps, manuals) to confirm “body only”.
Shutter count / EXIF model shown after a test shot (if available).
response.reason: The photos suggest a Nikon D750 from box text, but there’s no proof the exact body is present or that it powers on and works; key condition/function details are not visible, so pricing safely requires proof.
